translations.web: The watchman cried, and told the king. The king said, “If he is alone, there is news in his mouth.” He came closer and closer.
translations.bsb: So he called out and told the king. “If he is alone,” the king replied, “he bears good news.” As the first runner drew near,
translations.kjv: And the watchman cried, and told the king. And the king said, If he be alone, there is tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.
translations.asv: And the watchman cried, and told the king. And the king said, If he be alone, there is tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.
